title: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:20741:20080229:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Public Administration and Security and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20741, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (42) Omitted.

(43) The Regulations on Commissioning Honorary Mayors, Heads of Gun, etc. for Unrecovered Regions shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) and the main sentence of paragraph (3), "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" shall be replaced in each instance with "Minister of Public Administration and Security".

(44) through (105) Omitted.
